review.finding: Accepted residual risk: a scan that hits the 20 s timeout is not aborted; the queue moves on while the stalled read continues and pendingScans is already decremented, so stalled scans on a hung share can pile up beyond the cap.
review.suggestion: Follow-up: pass an AbortSignal into scanLines and abort on timeout, or hold the pendingScans slot until the scan settles.
